hero.name: Ronald Isaias Preciado Bermúdez
hero.bio: Software Engineer with solid experience in migrating and developing technological solutions. Proficient in both Frontend and Backend tools as well as database management. Professional oriented to teamwork and continuous improvement, seeking to integrate into challenging technical projects that drive my professional growth and provide strategic value to the organization.

section.about: It's not enough for code to work

1.title: Analytics Dashboard
1.desc: Interactive dashboard with real-time charts, advanced filters, and data export. Demonstrates complex state management and UX.

2.title: E-commerce with Cart & Payments
2.desc: Full store experience: catalog, persistent cart, checkout, and Stripe payment gateway. Showcases complete user flows.

3.title: Design System / UI Library
3.desc: Reusable component library documented with Storybook. Highly valued by product teams for consistency.

4.title: REST API with Full Auth
4.desc: Users CRUD, JWT authentication + refresh tokens, roles/permissions, rate limiting, and Swagger documentation.

5.title: Microservice with Messaging
5.desc: Orders or notifications system using RabbitMQ message queues. Demonstrates knowledge of distributed architectures.

6.title: GraphQL API with Subscriptions
6.desc: GraphQL API with queries, mutations, and real-time subscriptions. Differentiates from classic REST APIs.

7.title: Project Management SaaS
7.desc: Trello/Notion-style app with boards, drag & drop, real-time collaboration, and multi-tenancy.

8.title: Real-time Chat App
8.desc: Slack-like messaging: channels, DMs, push notifications, and paginated history. Demonstrates WebSocket proficiency.

1.desc: Leading the development of scalable microservices using .NET Core and React. Implementing clean architectures and design patterns. Mentoring junior teams and defining coding standards.

2.desc: Developed robust enterprise web applications. Migrated legacy systems to modern technologies. Optimized performance, reducing load times by 40%.

3.desc: Designed and implemented high-performance RESTful APIs. Integrated third-party systems and optimized database queries. Implemented caching strategies that reduced load by 50%.

4.desc: Built modern and responsive user interfaces. Implemented complex animations and optimized the platform's UX while collaborating closely with designers.

5.desc: Developed full features in web applications following best practices. Participated actively in code reviews and wrote unit tests achieving high test coverage.
